stories.title: Define Map Marker Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define the frontend data contract for map markers including provider ID, name, latitude, longitude, and display metadata to ensure consistent rendering across map components.
stories.evidence: Website/architecture.html (frontend mapping capability); Code/Schemas/ChatHealthy.Providers.json (provider data structure)

stories.title: Implement Map Rendering Component
stories.description: Build a reusable React map component that initializes map view, supports zoom/pan, and renders provider markers based on supplied coordinates.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/App.tsx (React frontend foundation); Website/architecture.html (UI capability for provider visualization)

stories.title: Marker Interaction and Provider Preview UI
stories.description: Enable user interaction with map markers including click/hover behavior to display provider preview details such as name and location context.

stories.title: Map Component Test Suite
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating map initialization, marker rendering, and interaction behavior including empty and multi-result scenarios.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend (React testing patterns implied); Website/tests/test_website.py (existing test framework presence)

stories.title: Bind Map to Provider Search Results
stories.description: Integrate map component with provider search output so that map updates dynamically based on user queries, including handling empty states and incremental result updates.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/facades/find_care_facade.py (provider search orchestration output consumed by frontend)
